description: This is a Java utility class named DateUtil that provides various static methods for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation, as well as a method for processing date inputs from an HTTP request. It also defines some instance variables for start and end dates.

classes.name: DateUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation, along with instance variables for managing start and end dates, including processing date inputs from HTTP requests.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string in 'yyyyMMddHHmmSS' format representing the current date and time.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string using the default date format defined in Constants.DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT.

methods.name: formatYear
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string representing only the year, using Constants.DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT_YEAR.

methods.name: formatLongDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a long date string using the pattern 'EEE, d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss Z'.

methods.name: formatDateMonthString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string using the default date format, similar to formatDate.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Parses a date string in the default date format into a Date object.

methods.name: addDaysToCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current date plus a specified number of days.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing the current date and time.

methods.name: getPresentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as a string in the default date format.

methods.name: getPresentYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: processPostedDates
methods.description: Processes 'startdate' and 'enddate' parameters from an HttpServletRequest and sets the instance variables 'startDate' and 'endDate'.
